incident_summary.dimension_slice: Region-B · CARD · MOBILE · INR · cart_items>12 (payment-risk amplifier)

impact.estimated_fail_fraction: ~2.8% of checkouts in the affected dimension
impact.notes: Root cause: node-image 2026.06.18 on NP-17 pinned RX-7 IRQ to CPU48 (NUMA1) while queue memory is on NUMA0 → AAAA DNS stall → payment pool exhaustion → checkout SLO. payment-provider latency is a false lead.

service_dependencies.isolation_note: Healthy siblings (pricing/inventory/token/fraud) are not on the failing payment path; impact concentrates on checkout→payment→(DNS/RX/IRQ) with payment-provider as a decoy leaf.

distributed_traces.false_lead_assessment: Payment-provider CLIENT/SERVER spans show ~17s duration on affected traces, but sibling services remain fast and only NP-17 payment pods correlate — treat external provider as a false lead; latency is consistent with pre-provider DNS/connection stall (AAAA / pool).
